correctness.rationale: The finite-chain generator has strictly positive real-part spectrum: a dark eigenvector would vanish at both ends and thus everywhere by nearest-neighbor recurrence. The unique stable Lyapunov equation is solved by explicit parity-restricted Green kernels; four exact all-index identities prove the entire matrix equality for all lengths and every positive rate. The diagonal formula is the survival-time integral; strict convexity proves the unique interior minimizer and boundary exception. A standalone checker exactly confirmed 338349 site pairs over lengths 2..100, and independent complex Sylvester solves confirmed 21 parameter cases; the proof does not rely on finite tests.

value.rationale: The result simultaneously determines every integrated survival operator entry (including coherent off-diagonal responses) for every finite two-end Lindblad chain, and extracts a sharp tunable absorber optimum with a nontrivial dependence on both distances to the boundaries. Two independent extraction channels are a natural quantum transport system, and the qualitative distinction between bulk and endpoint injection is relevant for trap placement and calibrated decay; it is not merely a one-point numerical statistic or a trivial corollary of the one-sink theorem.
